title: dendrolirium ferrugineum var. assamicum
intro: Dendrolirium ferrugineum var. assamicum, commonly known as the Assam variety of the Orchid Tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Dendrolirium ferrugineum var. assamicum include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing oxidative stress and modulating immune responses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been found to possess antimicrobial and antifungal properties.
